JOIN Paper AS p ON p.Id = pa.PaperId
JOIN Journal AS j ON j.Id = p.JournalId
WHERE pa.AuthorId = 627950
ORDER BY j.FullName;

SELECT DISTINCT j.FullName
FROM PaperAuthor AS pa
JOIN Paper AS p ON p.Id = pa.PaperId
JOIN Journal AS j ON j.Id = p.JournalId
WHERE pa.Name = 'Andrew Cain'
ORDER BY j.FullName;

SELECT DISTINCT p.JournalId, j.FullName
FROM PaperAuthor AS pa
JOIN Paper AS p ON p.Id = pa.PaperId
LEFT JOIN Journal AS j ON j.Id = p.JournalId
WHERE pa.AuthorId = 627950
ORDER BY p.JournalId;

SELECT DISTINCT j.FullName
FROM Journal AS j
JOIN Paper AS p ON p.JournalId = j.Id
JOIN PaperAuthor AS pa ON pa.PaperId = p.Id
WHERE pa.AuthorId IN (SELECT Id FROM Author WHERE Name = 'Andrew Cain')
ORDER BY j.FullName;
